title: Flashback! The Internet In 1995 | Archives | TODAY
summary: A short compilation of NBC Today show clips from 1994-95 in which hosts and guests puzzle over the World Wide Web and email. It includes Bill Gates and the Today anchors.
why: Cited as nostalgic comedy and as an example of media hype and misunderstanding around new technology, often in comparisons to Web3.

quote.text: even though they clearly had no idea what it really meant (not uncommon for morning TV).
